summary: Camera snatched on the Barcelona metro
story: On July 21 I was on the metro in Barcelona with my camera on a strap around my neck. As the doors were closing at Liceu station a man cut the strap, grabbed the camera and jumped off the train. It was over in a couple of seconds. I got off at the next stop and went straight to the police station on Nou de la Rambla, where I filed a report the same afternoon. The camera is a mirrorless body with its kit lens, which I bought together in February for $980. The police report and my purchase receipt are attached.

documents.name: Police report
documents.content: Mossos d'Esquadra, Ciutat Vella station, Barcelona. Report 548812/2026, filed July 21, 2026 at 16:40 by Sofia Reyes, US citizen. Theft by snatching on metro line L3 at Liceu station at about 15:10 the same day. One mirrorless camera with lens, strap cut. Suspect not identified.

documents.name: Purchase receipt
documents.content: Lone Star Camera, Austin, Texas, February 14, 2026. Mirrorless camera body with 18-55mm kit lens: $980.00.
